correctness.rationale: The orientation vector model yields a closed integer particle-flux cocycle on cubical squares. An explicit closed n-step path crosses each polygon vertex once, showing a unit evaluation and therefore a primitive H^1 generator in every nontrivial component. Coupled with the published n−1 circle decomposition, this fixes integral H_1 basis and action signs. The reflection reverses polygon order and bit convention (two sign changes), whereas complementing bits alone reverses the signed flux; signed finite cellular Lefschetz computations passed all 208 cases n=3..10. No claim of infinite proof from enumeration.
